# pion/sctp, vendored

Upstream: https://github.com/pion/sctp, tag `v1.11.3` (module `github.com/pion/sctp`, MIT, see `LICENSE`).
Copied from the Go module cache unchanged except that `.github/` (upstream CI) is left out.
The sidecar consumes it through `replace github.com/pion/sctp => ../third_party/pion-sctp` in
`../../sidecar/go.mod`; drop the directory and the `replace` once upstream ships the fix.
